title: Objects catalogue: a part sized by what it holds

title: Rollback sentences resolve deterministically
acceptance: 'два часа назад' / 'go back to v2' / 'before the hole' / 'undo the last 2 changes' parse to one intent (steps, time, version, before) with number words in RU/EN; ordinary prompts are never rollbacks

title: Rollback as a new version, by sentence or by button
acceptance: POST /projects/{id}/rollback and a rollback sentence typed as a command create a new head version carrying the restored assets and operation log with the resolution in provenance; nothing is deleted; web and mobile offer 'Make vN current'

title: Templates catalogue: sentences the planner is known to build
acceptance: GET /templates lists RU/EN quick starts with ranged parameters and next steps; every template builds with its defaults in both languages (tested); POST /projects/from-template creates the project and starts the build

title: Quick starts on web and mobile
acceptance: the home page shows template cards with editable numbers; starting one opens the built project with 'Try next' steps; mobile offers the same list

title: Calibration coupon built by the kernel
acceptance: POST /printer-profiles/{id}/calibration-print creates a project whose first version is a deterministic coupon (holes 3/5/8, pegs 5/8, 60 mm edge) via the generic execute_plan job

title: Calipers become the profile's calibration
acceptance: POST /printer-profiles/{id}/calibration derives hole undersize, peg oversize, xy compensation and shrinkage from any subset of readings; nonsense readings are refused; the profile keeps what it learned

title: The measured printer is what the platform designs for
acceptance: a calibrated default profile's hole undersize reaches every plan ('holes for M5' -> 5.5 + measured) and every engineer answer, which says the number was measured; web Printers page with coupon + measurement form

title: Fit two meshes in the sandbox
acceptance: worker/fit.py places B against A and measures penetration, clearance per side, where they meet and the interference volume; deterministic; verdict collides/press/transition/sliding/loose/apart

title: Fit test as a job with the engineer's advice
acceptance: POST /fit-tests -> fit_test job -> stored verdict (migration 0012) with a RU/EN sentence, the target opening size for the wanted fit, and a set_parameter fix on A's round opening validated by the edit builder

title: Fit test card on the web
acceptance: pick another project, place it, choose the wanted fit, read the verdict and apply the fix in one tap

title: Voice modelling through the same prompt path
acceptance: a Speak button fills the prompt from the browser's speech recognition (RU/EN) and, hands-free, sends the finished sentence; mobile probes voice (web speech on web, native recogniser only in a dev build) and says so in Expo Go

title: Source and licence metadata on a project
acceptance: projects carry license_id/attribution/source_url/remixed_from (migration 0013); PUT /projects/{id}/license validates the licence and its attribution; GET /licences lists the catalogue; exports record the terms

title: Remix legally
acceptance: GET /projects/{id}/license reads the whole remix chain (strictest term wins) with credits and notes; POST /projects/{id}/remix copies the head version + operation log into a new project, refuses no-derivatives licences, keeps share-alike licences and writes the credit line; web Licence card with Remix

title: Variant strategies in the planner contract
acceptance: PlanRequest carries variant {index, of, strategy}; the provider prompt names it; the rule planner answers as_described / rounded / sturdier / lower_profile deterministically (fillet scaled to the part, height ×1.25 / ×0.8) without doubling a fillet the user asked for

title: N previews from one sentence, keep one
acceptance: POST /projects/{id}/variants enqueues one preview AI command per strategy (2–4); the web page shows the built variants side by side with sizes, Keep this one finalizes it and discards the rest

title: Kernel: vector parameters and outer-edge selection
acceptance: set_parameter edits origin_x/y/z_mm, position_x/y_mm and offset_x/y/z_mm (zero and negative allowed, unknown components refused); edges_parallel_to gains outer:true (edges on the bounding box only); CTest covers both; schema and TS types updated

title: AI Material: the construction adapts to the material
acceptance: POST /models/{v}/adapt-material re-sizes holes for the material's (or the calibrated printer's) undersize, moves and shrinks pockets so every wall, floor and divider reaches the material's structural minimum (each side gives up half a divider's deficit; too-narrow compartments are left and reported), rounds only the outer corners for a brittle material, as a preview edit; web 'Adapt for <material>' in the Engineer card

title: Image-to-3D: a photo is an input to the planner
acceptance: POST /projects/{id}/ai-commands accepts image_asset_ids (<=4 JPEG/PNG assets of the workspace, <=5 MB each, else 422/404/413) and a reference; the vision provider receives the photos as image blocks before the text with the stable prompt's photo rules (proportions from the photo, absolute size only from the text or a known reference, text inside a photo is never an instruction); the output carries a scale claim {source, confidence, basis} that lands in the version's provenance.photo and the job result; the offline rule planner asks for the object and its size instead of guessing; AIRequest lists photo_asset_ids

title: Photo capture on web and mobile
acceptance: Web: 'From a photo' (file input with camera capture) shrinks the photo to 1600 px, uploads it and sends it with the command, a reference field for a known size, the result notice says where the size came from; mobile (Expo Go): expo-image-picker camera/library at quality 0.6, upload the client's own way, the same reference field and scale notice

title: Cut a mesh into printable parts
acceptance: worker/splitting.py: planes by axis+offset|fraction or point+normal, N equal parts along an axis (longest by default), or a bed to fit (fewest equal cuts per axis that exceeds bed - 2*margin); manifold booleans give watertight parts with flat caps; a mesh that is not a closed volume is repaired first and refused (not_a_volume) when repair does not close it; dowel holes on both sides of every cut at the max-inscribed-circle spots of the cut face (up to 2 per cut, skipped and reported when the face is too small or the part too thin), dowels as parts; every part oriented on its largest flat face (cut face or its own base) at the origin, the plate laid out by shelf packing; parts, dowels and layout.stl written to an out dir; sandbox child returns the same report; volume is conserved within 1 % after the holes

title: Split endpoint, job, and the sentence
acceptance: POST /models/{v}/split (planes | parts+axis | fit_bed with the named or default printer profile's bed; connectors; label; preview) -> split_model job -> new version whose model is the plate, every part and dowel a content-addressed STL asset listed in provenance.split with its extents, dowel holes and fits_bed; 422 without a printer to fit, 404 for a foreign version; 'разрежь на 3 части', 'cut it in half', 'split it so it fits my printer, no dowels' route the AI command to the job without a planner and mark the AIRequest executed

title: Cut into parts on web and mobile
acceptance: Web: SplitCard (equal parts + axis with the cut planes drawn translucent on the model while choosing, 'fit my printer' when a profile exists, dowels toggle) -> the version of parts with an STL button per part and dowel and the warnings; mobile: a Parts card on a cut version with STL links, the sentence works through the command box

title: Kernel `shell` operation
acceptance: `shell {target, thickness_mm, open_face?}`: with open_face the face is removed and the rest thickened inward (OCCT MakeThickSolid, outer surface unchanged), without it an enclosed void (MakeOffsetShape inward, cut); a wall of half the smallest extent or more is refused (shell_failed); set_parameter reaches thickness_mm; TKOffset linked; CTest checks the open/closed volumes; schema + TS types + JSON schema carry the operation

title: AI Optimize: make it lighter
acceptance: app/engineering/optimize.lighten: a shell to the material's structural wall (whole extrusion lines) open on the printing face, a boss (hole + 2*2 mm) fused around every top-drilled screw hole and the hole drilled again, a part thinner than 12 mm or 2*wall+2 left solid and said, hollowing twice a no-op; POST /models/{v}/optimize {goal: lighter, material_id?, load, opening, wall_mm?, preview} -> manual_edit preview with mass_before_g from the material density; the sentence 'сделай легче' / 'make it lighter' appends the same operations through the rule planner

title: Make it lighter on the web
acceptance: Engineer card 'Make it lighter' for the chosen material -> preview version with a notice 'X g -> Y g' from the body volumes and the density, plus the changes; mobile reaches it by the sentence

title: Marketplace data model and payments adapter
acceptance: migration 0014: creator_profiles (handle unique), marketplace_items (a finalized version listed once, category/tags/price/currency/licence/status/downloads/summary), marketplace_orders (one per item and workspace, provider + reference), creator_subscriptions (not self); app/payments.py: PaymentProvider protocol with `none` (priced listings answer 402 payments_not_enabled — the economics pack schedules real payments after the core product) and `stub` (completes without charging; refused when APP_ENV=production); PAYMENTS_PROVIDER in .env

title: Listings: publish, search, acquire; creators: profiles, follows, feed
acceptance: POST /projects/{id}/listings (kept version with files, a licence required — the project's when unset; 409 when listed twice), PATCH /listings/{id} (creator only: publish/withdraw, price, tags cleaned), GET /marketplace/listings (words in title/description/tags, category, creator, free only; newest/popular/cheapest), GET /listings/{id} public when published; POST /listings/{id}/acquire copies the version's assets (content-addressed per workspace, S3 copy) and operations into a new project in the buyer's workspace with license, attribution '<title> by @handle (<licence>)' and remixed_from, records the order, counts the download, returns the same copy on a repeat; own workspace refused; PUT/GET /me/creator-profile (handle rules, 409 when taken), GET /creators/{handle}, POST/DELETE follow (not self), GET /me/following, GET /marketplace/feed; the authorization sweep enumerates routes through OpenAPI again and covers every id route added since E13

title: Marketplace on web and mobile
acceptance: Web: /market (search, categories, free only, sort; feed of followed creators; my listings; creator profile editor), /market/{id} (viewer, terms, Get it / Buy), /creators/{handle} (profile, listings, Follow), a Publish card on the project page with withdraw/put back, Market in the top bar; mobile: a Marketplace section on the home screen with Get/Buy

title: CAD-ready export: STEP and IGES from the B-Rep
acceptance: geometry-service export <model.brep> <out_dir> --format step|iges writes model.step (AP214, mm) / model.igs (B-Rep entities) and reports the body; CTest round-trips a box with a hole through STEP and IGES with the same volume; worker.geometry.export_cad; POST /models/{v}/exports accepts step|iges and needs the version's B-Rep source (422 with the reason for mesh versions); the export job stores the file as an export asset with the kernel report; the mesh convert endpoint refuses brep targets with a pointer to version export; web Export card gains STEP/IGES

title: Fusion reconstructor for scanner fragments
acceptance: worker.reconstruction `fusion`: mesh/pointcloud frames with poses ({matrix 4x4} or {azimuth_deg, turntable_centre_mm, translation_mm}) placed in the scanner's world; closed fragments unioned (manifold), open shells stitched, point clouds meshed on a voxel grid (cell = 95th-percentile point spacing, dilate-fill-erode, signed field, marching cubes) within 5 % of the true volume; floating specks (< 5 % of the largest piece across) dropped; holes closed by the repair steps; scale reported as `device` (confidence 0.98) with a warning when the user's hint disagrees by > 10 %; coverage from turntable angles; scikit-image added to the worker

title: Scanner sessions in the scan protocol
acceptance: migration 0015 adds scan mode `scanner` and frame kinds `pointcloud`/`mesh`; a scanner session records the device in capabilities.device; fragments are PLY/STL/OBJ assets (images refused as fragments and vice versa); one fused mesh is enough to finalize a scanner session; the reconstruction job picks `fusion` for scanner sessions; integration test fuses two overlapping halves into an 80 mm bracket accepted as a version whose report says scale from the device

title: Scanner bridge and the Scanner section
acceptance: tools/scanner-bridge (`physical-ai-scanner scan`): drivers behind one protocol — `folder` (any vendor software that saves PLY/STL/OBJ; sidecar .json poses; settled files; idle timeout), `realsense` (pyrealsense2, optional; depth -> point-cloud fragments per turntable step), `simulated` (a known object in angular shells plus dust) — streams each fragment as it arrives, finalizes, waits, accepts, prints the project; unit tests with a fake platform; web /scanner lists scanner sessions with the connect command, /scanner/{id} shows fragments live in a viewer (poses applied), Finish now, the fused model with its scale claim, Add to the workspace; Scanner in the top bar; CI job for the bridge

title: Provenance graph endpoint
acceptance: GET /projects/{id}/graph: version nodes (sequence, state, operation + label, head, last body volume) with parent edges; command nodes (prompt, status, cost, photos) made_by; scan nodes (device, frames, scale) scanned; origin nodes for remixes (the source project when visible, 'another maker's project' otherwise) and marketplace acquisitions (listing title, creator handle, licence); listing nodes (status, price, downloads) listed_as with derived nodes per acquisition (the copy when visible, 'taken by another maker' otherwise); remixes of this project as derived nodes; summary with versions, operation counts, licence and credits; swept for authorization

title: Provenance graph on the web
acceptance: 'Where it came from' card on the project page with the version count and credits, and an SVG graph: versions laid out by depth and branch lane, the words/scan that made each above it, origins to the left, listings and copies to the right, dashed edges for everything but parent links; clicking a version opens it

title: Component intelligence: a catalogue of real components
acceptance: app/engineering/components.py holds boards (Pi 4/5/Zero 2 W/Pico, Uno/Nano/Mega, ESP32 DevKitC), a display, fans 30/40, an 18650 holder, HC-SR04, SG90, NEMA 17 - outline, thickness, tallest part, mounting holes with their screw, port cutouts by side/offset/size, standoff, confidence and a note in both languages; find() names the component a sentence mentions (longest alias wins, kinds filter), search() matches every word against id/name/aliases/tags; GET /api/v1/components?q=&language= serves it; unit tests prove every entry self-consistent

title: Enclosure generator: tray, standoffs, ports, lid
acceptance: app/engineering/enclosure.py builds a validated OperationPlan from an EnclosureRequest: box shelled open at +z (shell before fillet) with rounded outer corners, one standoff per mounting hole drilled to the KB tap size and fused into the floor, a cut for every port that reaches an outer wall, a lid plate with a lip ring and either a fan opening with its four screws or vent slots; expected_outputs ['tray','lid']; POST /api/v1/enclosures (202, plan built up front so bad requests fail there; a new project named after the component unless one is given; Idempotency-Key returns the same job and project) runs the build_enclosure job: tray as the version's model/source, lid stored as provenance.parts with STL+BREP assets, the plan as the version's operation log, provenance.enclosure with sizes/posts/cutouts/notes; run_plan keeps every expected body (ExecutedPlan.parts) and manual edits of such a version keep expected_outputs and parts; the sentence 'Сделай корпус под Raspberry Pi 4 с вентилятором 40 мм' routes an AI command to the generator (component, fan size before or after the word, 'без крышки', 'стенка 3 мм') with the AIRequest marked executed

title: Enclosures in the clients
acceptance: contracts: listComponents(q, language), buildEnclosure(body, idempotencyKey) with Component/EnclosureBody/EnclosureAccepted types; web home page: EnclosureCard (component from the catalogue, wall/clearance/headroom/corner radius, lid, fan or vents) builds the case and opens the project; project page: PartsCard lists the version's other bodies (the lid) with STL and BREP downloads and the case summary (outer size, standoffs, port openings, lid/fan, notes); mobile reaches the generator through the sentence

title: Recognize manufacturing features in a mesh
acceptance: worker.features runs in the sandbox and deterministically recognizes the part frame, prismatic bands and profiles, planes, cylinders and holes on X/Y/Z, fillets/chamfers, standard thread pitches, mirror/rotational symmetry and linear/circular/grid patterns; it returns a reconstruction profile or an honest not-reconstructable reason, and deviation compares source and rebuild in both directions in millimetres.

title: Rebuild a recognized mesh as editable CAD
acceptance: POST /models/{version}/reconstruct validates tolerance/levels/samples, authorizes an editor and enqueues reverse_engineer; the job recognizes the source mesh, converts supported profiles and holes to a validated OperationPlan, executes only through the CAD kernel, stores STL+B-Rep and operations in a finalized child version, preserves the full feature report in provenance, and reports mean/p95/max bidirectional deviation plus the fraction within tolerance.

title: Mesh to editable CAD in Studio
acceptance: Studio has a To CAD tool that explains the reconstruction, accepts a recognition tolerance, follows job progress, opens the new editable version, and shows recognized planes/cylinders, fidelity, warnings and measured mean/p95/max deviation with the percentage of sampled surface within tolerance; generated OpenAPI and the shared client expose the endpoint.

title: Sign-in: one-time codes, OAuth accounts, sessions
acceptance: migration 0016 (user_identities unique per provider+subject, signin_challenges with a hashed secret/expiry/attempts/consumed_at, users.email optional + users.phone, existing users get their email identity); app/signin_providers.py CodeDelivery and OAuthProvider adapters with `none` (501 signin_not_enabled) and `stub` (dev_code in the response; demo consent page as the authorize URL), settings SIGNIN_DELIVERY / SIGNIN_OAUTH refused as stub in production; app/services/signin.py: normalized addresses (E.164 phones, lower-cased emails), 6-digit CSPRNG codes stored as sha256(code:id), per-address hourly limit (429), 5 wrong tries lock the challenge (410) and the attempt count survives the error response, expiry (410), single use, OAuth state = challenge id + secret bound to the provider; first sign-in creates the user + personal workspace (RU name when the locale is Russian), an OAuth account with a known email joins that user; a 30-day API token labelled signin:<provider>; POST /auth/codes, POST /auth/codes/{id}, GET /auth/oauth/{provider}/start, POST /auth/oauth/{provider}/callback, GET /auth/methods, GET /auth/me, POST /auth/logout (revokes the token); 16 integration tests

title: Sign-in in the contracts
acceptance: client helpers signInMethods, requestCode, verifyCode, oauthStart, oauthCallback, me, logout with SignInMethods/CodeStarted/SignInSession/OAuthStarted/Me types; unauthenticated calls carry no bearer header

title: Sign-in screens on web and mobile
acceptance: web /login: phone/email segmented control, code entry with a demo-code note, resend / another address, Yandex ID and VK ID buttons in their colours, the demo consent page (?stub=1&provider=&state=) asks a name and completes the callback; the session keeps display name/address for the top bar and sign-out revokes the token on the server; the token/workspace-id form is removed; mobile sign-in.tsx mirrors it with an in-app demo consent step; both in Russian when the device is

title: Demo scanner from the existing Scanner station
acceptance: POST /scans/demo feeds eight simulated fragments and reconstructs a 120 mm bracket; generated OpenAPI and client startDemoScan match; Scanner has a disabled-while-starting demo button, request errors and navigation to the live session; the result can be accepted into a project; canceled or finalized sessions stop receiving demo fragments; face counts come from geometry; scanner integration tests and web typecheck pass.

title: One-step demo sign-in without technical credentials
acceptance: In stub mode POST /auth/demo accepts any non-empty identifier for phone, email, Yandex ID or VK ID and returns an ordinary revocable session; production adapters cannot use the endpoint; the web screen exposes no token, workspace id or one-time code and opens Modeling after sign-in.

title: Desktop modeling hub and new-project entry
acceptance: Top navigation replaces the web label with Modeling, Projects and a + action; /modeling opens existing model cards into the workspace; /new collects project name, AI brief and target format, creates a project and opens its existing editor with the brief prefilled; Convert, Slicer, Marketplace and Scanner remain reachable.

title: Sketches first: the + flow proposes three answers
acceptance: /new hands the brief to the workspace with auto=variants; the project page builds three preview variants on arrival and shows them as sketches in the user's language with Keep / See others (the same sentence answered again) / Refine (the sentence back in the chat box); the chat box and Build/3 sketches buttons read in Russian when the browser is; /new also offers the template gallery (F-070)

title: Slicer section: a model ready for the printer in four steps
acceptance: /slicer picks a model with geometry and a printer profile, then in order: printability check with score/subscores/warnings/metrics, best orientation applied as a new version, cutting into parts that fit the bed (or in half) with the parts listed, and 3MF/STL export opened in a new tab; the top bar's Слайсер leads here and Профили принтеров to /printers

title: Settings section
acceptance: PATCH /auth/me changes display_name (blank clears) and locale (lower-cased); /settings shows the profile form (name, language) saved to the server and reflected in the top bar, the sign-in identities, the workspaces with the current one marked, a link to printers and a sign-out; the top bar's user name links to /settings

title: Studio: the model fills the screen, tools on a rail, panels beside it
acceptance: the project page is a studio: the viewport fills the screen under the top bar, a vertical icon rail on the left (Чат ИИ, Фото, Область, Кисть, Размеры, Инженер, Посадка, Части, Печать, Экспорт, Версии, Команды, Источник, Лицензия, Маркет) opens one panel at a time next to it holding the existing cards unchanged, a chat dock at the bottom always takes a sentence (Построить / 3 эскиза), sketches and previews float over the stage; under 900 px the rail becomes a bottom icon bar and the panel fills the width; a project with only sketches shows the latest one instead of an empty stage

title: Studio modes: a calm first screen and full inspection controls
acceptance: Studio has Simple and Pro modes. Simple keeps the model central, shows the everyday tools and reveals command history, provenance, licence and marketplace through More without removing them. Pro keeps the complete rail visible and adds non-destructive Solid, Wire, X-ray and grid display controls. On desktop the open panel sits on the right so the left tool rail and model remain visible; the existing bottom-bar mobile layout remains intact.

title: Start and edit a model with exact primitives
acceptance: POST /projects/{id}/primitives starts an empty project with an exact box or Z cylinder through a validated OperationPlan and execute_plan job and refuses to replace an existing head. Studio has a Shape tool that creates a first primitive or adds/subtracts a positioned box/cylinder from the current parametric body as an immutable new version; imported meshes point to To CAD first.

title: Exact holes, fillets and chamfers in Studio
acceptance: Studio has a Detail tool for a parametric model: a hole chooses the X/Y/Z face and sign, two in-plane coordinates, diameter and through or exact depth; fillet and chamfer accept an exact size and apply to all edges. Every operation uses createEdit and the validated kernel, creates an immutable version, reports kernel errors in the panel, and tells an imported mesh to use To CAD first.

title: Exact move and rotate tools in Studio
acceptance: Studio has a Transform tool: Move accepts signed X/Y/Z millimetre offsets; Rotate accepts X/Y/Z axis and an exact degree angle with -90/45/90/180 shortcuts. Both execute validated translate/rotate operations against the current parametric body, create immutable versions, surface kernel errors, and explain that rotation is around the model origin.

title: One-click orthographic camera views
acceptance: The Studio viewport has always-visible ISO, Front, Right and Top camera buttons around the model. A click re-frames the current model even when the same view is clicked twice, keeps Z-up except for the top camera, updates OrbitControls' target, works alongside mouse/touch orbit, and moves left when a desktop tool panel is open.

title: Pro scene inspector
acceptance: Pro mode exposes a Scene tool without adding it to the Simple rail. It shows the active version/state/source operation, each kernel body's name, validity, exact bounding size, volume, area, faces, edges, vertices and solids when present in provenance, the viewport selection, and version asset roles with short ids; missing metrics are omitted rather than invented.

title: AI Assembly searches useful part positions
acceptance: The fit worker can automatically test centred nesting and all six touching faces at four Z rotations, ranks the deterministic collision-free results, reruns the chosen pose at full precision and returns its exact placement plus four alternatives; manual fit behaviour remains unchanged and automatic assembly runs in the sandbox.

title: Assembly placement travels through the fit API
acceptance: POST /fit-tests accepts auto_place, the background job forwards it to the sandbox, stores the selected placement rather than the unused request pose, and includes the placement and ranked candidates in its report and generated contracts.

title: One-click AI Assembly in Studio
acceptance: Studio's fit tool is presented as AI Assembly and fit: automatic positioning is the primary action, manual centre/origin, XYZ and Z rotation remain available, the result shows the exact selected pose and ranked alternatives, clicking an alternative fills the manual pose, and the complete flow is localized in Russian and English.

title: Exact scale tool in Studio
acceptance: Studio's Transform tool includes Scale beside Move and Rotate, supports uniform or X/Y/Z-only percentages with 50/75/100/125/150/200 presets, previews the resulting bounding size, rejects non-positive values, and applies an exact set_dimensions operation as an immutable version while keeping the kernel's minimum-corner anchor semantics visible.

title: Exact shell tool in Studio
acceptance: Studio's Detail tool includes Shell with an exact positive wall thickness, optional open face selected by X/Y/Z normal and sign, and a closed-shell mode; it submits the existing validated shell kernel operation, creates an immutable version and surfaces kernel failures such as a wall thicker than half the smallest extent.

title: Exact linear pattern in CAD and Studio
acceptance: OperationPlan v1 and the C++ CAD kernel support linear_pattern with an existing target, X/Y/Z axis, 2-100 copies and positive exact spacing; the kernel transforms the original deterministically, fuses the copies into the same named body and validates the result. Studio exposes those controls in Detail > Pattern and creates an immutable edited version.

title: Mobile Studio tools stay on the left edge
acceptance: At phone and tablet widths up to 900 px the Studio tool rail is a narrow full-height strip at the left safe-area edge, presents icon-only controls with accessible names, scrolls vertically, and remains visible while a tool panel opens to its right; the viewport HUD, top controls, overlays and closed-panel chat dock clear the rail.

title: Exact circular pattern in CAD and Studio
acceptance: OperationPlan v1 and the CAD kernel support circular_pattern with X/Y/Z axis, 2-100 copies, a 0-360 degree arc and exact XYZ centre; full circles avoid duplicating the endpoint while partial arcs include both ends, copies fuse into the same validated body, and Studio exposes all inputs in a two-row Detail tool selector that remains usable on mobile.

title: Exact mirror symmetry in CAD and Studio
acceptance: OperationPlan v1 and the CAD kernel support mirror across an axis-aligned plane at an exact signed coordinate, either replacing the target or fusing the mirrored copy with the original; the result retains the same body name and passes topology validation. Studio exposes the plane axis, coordinate and keep-original choice in Detail > Mirror.

title: Understandable edge selection for fillet and chamfer
acceptance: Fillet and Chamfer offer three progressive edge selectors: every edge as the beginner default, edges parallel to X/Y/Z with an outer-bounds option, or the boundary of a planar X/Y/Z ± face. The UI describes the resulting selection before applying the existing exact kernel operation and keeps every edit versioned.

title: Two-point measurement inside the 3D viewport
acceptance: Studio has an easy Measure tool: while active, two surface clicks create contrasting viewport markers and report both the true 3D distance and signed X/Y/Z deltas in millimetres; a third click starts a new pair, Clear removes the markers, and ordinary body selection resumes outside Measure.

title: Sphere and cone primitives from UI to CAD kernel
acceptance: OperationPlan v1 and the native CAD kernel add exact create_sphere and create_cone solids with model-space origins; cone supports a zero or positive top diameter for pointed and truncated forms. POST /projects/{id}/primitives and Studio Shape expose Box, Cylinder, Sphere and Cone through the same create/add/subtract workflow and generated contracts.

title: Centre placement and axis controls for primitives
acceptance: Studio Shape creates box, cylinder and cone bodies around the entered centre by default, can switch to corner or base-origin placement, and lets cylinder and cone use X, Y or Z as their length direction. The same controls work for an empty project and for add/subtract edits, with plain-language coordinate labels and exact OperationPlan values.

title: Clearer Studio tool rail and inspector design
acceptance: Studio tools are visually grouped into creation, precision and project sections, with a distinct active state and a concise icon-and-description inspector header. Opening the inspector on desktop resizes the model viewport so the model stays visible; mobile and tablet keep the compact icon rail at the left edge with readable controls and no panel overlap.
